support_evidence_summary: The film 'Heaven Is a Playground' stars Bo Kimble and Richard Jordan, who is a long-time member of the New York Shakespeare Festival and performed in many Broadway plays. Rick Telander has a cameo appearance in the film.

state_snapshot.K_t:
Evidence:
[1] He came to prominence in 1996, as an original company member and Dance Captain in the George C. Wolfe-produced musical "Bring in 'Da Noise, Bring in 'Da Funk" at both The Joseph Papp Public Theater/New York Shakespeare Festival and on Broadway.
[2] Telander himself has a cameo appearance in the movie.
[3] A long-time member of the New York Shakespeare Festival, he performed in many Off Broadway and Broadway plays.
